runs.content: Universal Health Services (NYSE, $177.08) was bought as the day's value pick. It trades at ~7x earnings with positive FCF, 27% below its 52-week high; it's a Burry-aligned peer of his HCA long, and Q3 results land on 10-26. INCY was exited as a capacity trim (−8.50%, −$85); it was the weakest position and its momentum premise had failed. No stop/T1/T2 triggers; CVX is $9.93 from T1 and HPQ is $5.79 from T2. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,413 (+1.94% on $73,000).

Carnival (NYSE, $25.76) was bought as the day's earnings-catalyst pick. Its 09-29 Q3 beat (EPS $1.43 vs $1.35) raised FY26 EPS guidance to $2.24 on record yields and deposits, yet the stock trades ~11.5x that guidance and 24% below its 52-week high, and it adds travel/leisure exposure to a healthcare- and energy-heavy book. ICE was exited as a capacity trim (−6.57%, −$66; weakest position, no thesis break). No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $3.17 from T1 and HPQ is $5.40 from T2. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,156 (+1.61% on $72,000).
